minutes_text:
City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  November 22 2021

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was a call In Meeting at 1+ (669) 900-6833; Meeting
ID: 960 5053 9618 Passcode: 017243 at 9:33 am.

  Members Present:  Maria Heaney, Finance Department
  Derald Brenneman City Attorney’s Office
  Aisha Thompson, City Clerk’s Office

  Staff Present:  Jose Cortes, Human Resources
  Amber Haley, Fleet Maintenance

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

  1. The minutes of November 08, 2021, meeting was approved as recorded.

  2. Expresscare Medical Clinic, Inc – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for
  providing pre-employment physicals for the City the amount of $760.00. Motion carried
  unanimously.

  3. Hillcrest Medical Clinic – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing pre-
  employment and DMV physical exams for the City in the amount of $220.00. Motion carried
  unanimously.

  4. Inglewood Tow Services, Inc – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for the
  towing services for the city owned vehicles for the Fleet Department in the amount of
  $4,514.00. Motion carried unanimously.

  5. B & H Inglewood Tow, Inc – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing
  towing services for the Police and Fleet Departments in the amount of $704.00. Motion carried
  unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Maria Heaney reported no public comments. There being no further business, the meeting adjourned
at 9:45 a.m.

Adjournment
